[ 'T' BIND 'F' BIND 'X' BIND X F 2 COLLECT 0 1 T SELECT GET ] 'S0A.PICK' DEF
[ 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A NOT B NOT AND NOT ] 'S0A.OR' DEF
[ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET 'L' BIND A A LENGTH 1 SUB E L 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT A E 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT L 0 GET E EQ S0A.PICK ] 'S0A.RLESTEP' DEF
[ 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ S0A.RLESTEP ] FOLD ] 'S0A.RLE' DEF
[ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 2 GET 'B' BIND A 1 GET 1 ADD 1 E A 0 GET GT SELECT 'C' BIND E C B C MAX 3 COLLECT ] 'S0A.UPSTEP' DEF
[ 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 0 0 3 COLLECT [ S0A.UPSTEP ] FOLD 2 GET ] 'S0A.UPRUNS' DEF
[ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A A E 1 COLLECT CONCAT A -1 GET E EQ S0A.PICK ] 'S0A.DDSTEP' DEF
[ 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET 1 COLLECT [ S0A.DDSTEP ] FOLD ] 'S0A.DEDUPE' DEF
[ UNIQUE SORT 'U' BIND U -2 GET NIL U LENGTH 1 GT SELECT ] 'S0A.SECOND' DEF
[ 'V' BIND V V SORT V LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET 'C' BIND V [ C EQ ] FILTER LENGTH 2 MUL V LENGTH GT 'T' BIND C NIL T SELECT ] 'S0A.MAJORITY' DEF
[ 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D DIV 'Q' BIND Q Q FLOOR EQ ] FILTER ] 'S0A.DIVISORS' DEF
[ 'M' BIND 1 M RANGE [ S0A.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER ] 'S0A.PRIMES' DEF
[ 'N' BIND 0 5 RANGE [ 'K' BIND 2 K POW ] MAP [ N GT NOT ] FILTER REVERSE 'P' BIND N P DIV FLOOR 'Q' BIND Q Q 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR JOIN ] 'S0A.BINARY' DEF
[ 'I' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'X' BIND A 1 GET 'S' BIND X 2 DIV 'H' BIND H X 3 MUL 1 ADD H H FLOOR EQ SELECT 'Y' BIND X 1 EQ 'D' BIND X Y D SELECT S S 1 ADD D SELECT 2 COLLECT ] 'S0A.CZSTEP' DEF
[ 'N' BIND 1 150 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ S0A.CZSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET ] 'S0A.COLLATZ' DEF
[ 1 SUB 'M' BIND M M 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD ] 'S0A.DROOT' DEF
[ 'N' BIND 1 12 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'I' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 GET A 0 GET A 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ N LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD ] 'S0A.FIBINDEX' DEF
[ CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 C '(' EQ C '[' EQ S0A.OR SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD ] 'S0A.DEPTH' DEF
[ 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT [ 'Z' ] A CONCAT -1 GET C 2 COLLECT JOIN 'P' BIND P '()' EQ P '[]' EQ S0A.OR S0A.PICK ] 'S0A.RED' DEF
[ CHARS [ ] [ S0A.RED ] FOLD [ ] EQ ] 'S0A.BALANCED' DEF
[ CHARS [ ] [ S0A.RED ] SCAN 'S' BIND [ [ ] ] S CONCAT 'T' BIND 0 S LENGTH RANGE [ 'I' BIND T I GET [ ] EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD ] 'S0A.BPREFIX' DEF
[ CHARS [ ] [ S0A.RED ] FOLD LENGTH ] 'S0A.UNMATCHED' DEF
